human_priority: 25Oct research and improve correctness before caption ablations
target_quantity: visible apparent target-surface color in the source image, not intrinsic reflectance recovered under canonical light
extended_color_policy: tan/beige/cream/khaki/maroon require separate color calibration; silver/gold material/appearance and blond hair-only remain separate, not silently normalized in original GT
sampling: same frozen200 TRAIN target nodes for engineering pilot; no TEST reads, old color-check already observed and cannot be relabeled fresh check

photometry.RGB_order: RGB input explicitly; BGR only in OpenCV GrabCut conversion
photometry.lookup: author32768x11 sRGB table, original R+32G+1024B indexing
photometry.image_manipulation_for_statistics: none; only original mask pixels count; no gray/black background fill, no per-object histogram equalization or gray-world correction
photometry.illumination_guard: compare color on original and mild exposure perturbations (.9,1.1); if primary is unstable, unknown. This is sensitivity, not recovered illumination.
photometry.achromatic_policy: do not discard low-saturation pixels; gray/white/black can be genuine target colors; darkness alone never overrides learned naming
photometry.highlight_policy: report clipping share; refuse severely clipped/underexposed crops, do not delete all white/black pixels

CLIP.role: secondary contradiction signal, never sole color source or probability
